items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was aware of him in the ‘40s.

ctx.x: I think you stated in an interview I read that you’d been listening to him back in the ‘40s, his early recordings.
Yes. I was aware of him in the ‘40s. He made the first record, I think, with Art Blakey, on the Blue Note label, I think.
Yes, his early recordings were for Blue Note.
